mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, type, sys_id, sys_name, effective_time, expire_time, is_expire, third_id, third_code, third_name, third_sys_type, remark
mapper.select: select m.* from third_mapping m left join third_shop w on m.third_id = w.shop_id where m.disabled = false and w.disabled = false and m.third_sys_type = #{sysType} and m.type = 'shop' and m.is_deleted = false and w.is_deleted = false and w.code = #{thirdCode} limit 1
